The same header and three rows of data as CSV and JSONTypedTable (JTT).
-- data.csv --
Name,Age,Salary,Retiring,Notes
Foo,1,2.1,false,
Bar,4,6.75,true,
Baz,2,2.5,false,"wants to be promoted to ""Boss"", and
get a raise"
-- data.jtt --
"Name"	"Age"	"Salary"	"Retiring"	"Notes"
"Foo"	1	2.1	false	""
"Bar"	4	6.75	true	null
"Baz"	2	2.5	false	"wants to be promoted to \"Boss\", and\nget a raise"
